purpose: Allow customer paxd through interactive Access while retaining Manager authentication.
preconditions: Inspect existing Access applications and policies, including more-specific overrides; record IDs for rollback.
Deploy and verify the 28-route Manager method/template guard before any path bypass.
Keep production local-auth flags false and published ports on loopback.
preserve_protection: api.lakeward.net and wsapi.lakeward.net outside the listed machine scopes
notes: This is a review checklist, not a Cloudflare API request payload.
Access wildcard path matching is coarser than the Manager method/template guard; the guard is mandatory.
A more-specific Access application overrides the broader application and does not inherit its policies.
No shared Access service token is distributed to customer nodes.
Public installer and object-storage delivery are separate scopes; do not infer their bypass from this plan.
KEV-36 through KEV-40 track additional hardening separately from this scoped CF client removal.
rollback: Remove only the newly added bypass apps/policies using recorded IDs; retain existing applications. No tunnel or container restart is required for an Access-policy-only rollback.
